enriched_activities.desc: Lies on the bed on the right side. Pulls the blanket up to the shoulders. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly and evenly. Rolls onto the back. Extends the left arm. Rolls onto the left side. Pulls the pillow down under the head. Bends the knees. Remains still. Turns the head to the other side. Stretches both legs. Rolls onto the right side again. Pulls the blanket up over the shoulder. Remains lying without movement until the alarm at 06:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet and taking a morning shower
enriched_activities.desc: Reaches the right arm to the phone on the bedside table. Presses the alarm button to stop it. Sits up on the edge of the bed. Puts both feet on the floor. Stands up. Walks to the bathroom door. Pushes the door open. Turns on the bathroom light switch. Lifts the toilet lid. Sits on the toilet. Stands up. Presses the flush button. Walks to the shower. Turns the water heater switch on. Turns the shower tap to the left. Holds the right hand under the water to test the temperature. Steps into the shower. Picks up the shampoo bottle. Pours shampoo into the left palm. Rubs the scalp with both hands. Rinses the head under the water. Picks up the soap. Rubs the soap over the arms, chest and legs. Rinses the body. Turns the tap to the right to stop the water. Steps out of the shower. Pulls the towel off the rail. Rubs the hair with the towel. Wipes the arms, chest and legs. Hangs the towel back on the rail. Turns the light switch off. Opens the door and walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Light stretching and watching morning news on the TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the living room. Picks up the TV remote from the coffee table. Presses the power button. Points the remote at the TV and selects the news channel. Puts the remote down on the table. Stands on the mat. Raises both arms above the head. Bends the torso to the left. Bends the torso to the right. Bends forward and reaches the hands toward the floor. Straightens up. Rotates the shoulders backward. Rotates the neck to the left and to the right. Sits down on the sofa. Picks up the remote. Turns the volume up one step. Puts the remote down. Watches the news on the screen. Stands up. Picks up the remote. Presses the power button to turn the TV off. Puts the remote back on the coffee table. Walks toward the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 2, listening to a podcast on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the kitchen. Says 'Morning' to Member 2. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out the milk and eggs. Closes the refrigerator door. Puts the items on the counter. Picks up the kettle. Fills it with water at the tap. Puts the kettle on the base and presses the switch. Picks up the toaster plug and pushes it into the socket. Places two slices of bread into the toaster slots. Presses the toaster lever down. Picks up the phone from the counter. Opens the podcast app. Presses play. Puts the phone down next to the counter. Picks up a bowl from the cupboard. Cracks two eggs into the bowl. Picks up a fork. Beats the eggs. Pours the eggs into the pan on the induction cooker. Presses the induction cooker button to start. Stirs the eggs with the spatula. Presses the button to stop the heat. Picks up the toast from the toaster. Puts the toast on two plates. Divides the eggs onto the two plates. Pours the milk into two glasses. Pours the hot water into two cups. Carries the plates and cups to the table. Sits down on the chair opposite Member 2. Eats the eggs and toast with a fork. Drinks the milk. Says 'The kettle boiled fast today' to Member 2. Picks up the plates. Stands up. Carries the plates to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the desk lamp and computer, reviewing the day's program schedule and emails
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 1. Pulls the chair out from the desk. Sits down. Presses the desk lamp switch to turn it on. Adjusts the lamp arm toward the desk. Picks up the computer from the desk. Opens the lid. Presses the power button. Types the login password on the keyboard. Opens the email application. Scrolls through the inbox with the mouse. Opens the first email. Reads it. Clicks reply. Types a short reply. Clicks send. Opens the calendar window. Clicks on today's date. Reads the program schedule entries. Picks up a notebook and a pen from the desk drawer. Writes down three appointment times. Puts the pen down. Presses the fan switch to turn the fan on. Adjusts the fan to the low setting. Opens the program planning document. Scrolls through the pages.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on the computer: drafting community program plans, coordinating partner organizations and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at the desk facing the computer. Places both hands on the keyboard. Types the draft of the community program plan. Stops typing. Reads the paragraph on the screen. Clicks into the document to move the cursor. Deletes a sentence with the backspace key. Types a new sentence. Opens the spreadsheet for the program budget. Types numbers into the cells. Clicks the sum function. Saves the file with Ctrl+S. Picks up the phone. Opens the messaging app. Types a message to a partner organization. Sends it. Puts the phone down. Opens the email application. Reads a new email. Clicks reply. Types the reply. Clicks send. Opens the next email. Clicks forward. Types the recipient address. Clicks send. Stands up from the chair. Walks to the door. Walks back to the desk. Sits down again. Picks up the water glass. Drinks. Puts the glass down. Continues typing on the keyboard. Joins a video call. Speaks into the microphone: 'We can confirm the venue for next week.' Clicks leave meeting. Picks up the phone. Reads a new message. Types a reply. Puts the phone down on the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch with Member 2, then tidying the counters
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the kitchen. Says 'I'll get the vegetables' to Member 2. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out the lettuce, tomatoes and cheese. Closes the door. Puts the items on the counter. Picks up a knife from the drawer. Cuts the tomatoes on the cutting board. Picks up the lettuce. Tears the leaves into a bowl. Picks up the cheese. Cuts it into slices. Opens the cupboard. Takes out two plates and two forks. Places them on the table. Opens the microwave door. Puts a container of rice inside. Closes the door. Presses the start button. Waits. Presses the stop button when it beeps. Opens the door. Takes out the container. Closes the door. Divides the rice onto the two plates. Carries the bowls to the table. Sits down on the chair. Eats with the fork. Drinks water from the glass. Says 'The budget report is almost done' to Member 2. Picks up the plates and bowls. Stands up. Carries them to the sink. Picks up the sponge. Wipes the counter with the sponge. Rinses the sponge. Puts the sponge back on the holder. Wipes the table with a cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short afternoon walk around the neighborhood with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to the front door. Picks up the keys from the hook. Opens the door. Steps outside. Waits for Member 2 to step out. Closes the door. Puts the keys in the jacket pocket. Walks down the stairs. Turns right at the sidewalk. Walks beside Member 2 at a slow pace. Swings both arms. Says 'It's a good day for a walk' to Member 2. Turns left at the corner. Walks past the shops. Steps around a puddle on the pavement. Continues to the end of the block. Turns around. Walks back along the same street. Turns right at the corner. Walks up the stairs. Stops at the front door. Takes the keys from the pocket. Puts the key into the lock. Turns the key. Opens the door. Steps inside. Holds the door for Member 2. Closes the door. Hangs the keys back on the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work from home on the computer: video calls, updating budgets and preparing grant reports
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 1. Pulls the chair out. Sits down. Presses the spacebar to wake the computer. Types the login password. Opens the video call application. Clicks join meeting. Adjusts the headset microphone. Speaks: 'Can everyone see the budget slide?' Clicks screen share. Points at the numbers on the screen with the cursor. Answers a question: 'The partner fee is included in this line.' Clicks stop sharing. Clicks leave meeting. Closes the video call window. Opens the budget spreadsheet. Types new figures into the cells. Deletes one row with the right-click menu. Clicks the sort function. Saves the file with Ctrl+S. Opens the grant report document. Types the summary paragraph. Scrolls down. Types the outcome figures. Adds a table with the insert menu. Saves the report. Opens the email application. Attaches the report file. Types the recipient address. Clicks send. Picks up the phone. Reads a message. Types a reply. Puts the phone down. Opens the program plan document. Reads it. Types two more sentences. Saves the file. Leans back in the chair. Raises both arms overhead. Lowers the arms. Presses the desk lamp switch off. Stands up. Pushes the chair back in.

enriched_activities.activity: Unwinding on the sofa, browsing the phone and resting after work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the living room. Sits down on the sofa. Leans back against the cushions. Stretches both legs out. Picks up the phone from the pocket. Presses the power button. Unlocks the screen with the fingerprint. Opens the news app. Scrolls down with the thumb. Opens a video. Watches it. Closes the video. Opens the messaging app. Reads a message from Member 2. Types a reply. Sends it. Puts the phone down on the sofa seat. Closes the eyes. Breathes slowly. Opens the eyes. Picks up the phone again. Scrolls through the photo gallery. Puts the phone down on the coffee table. Stands up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and oven
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the kitchen. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out the chicken, broccoli and onion. Closes the door. Puts the items on the counter. Picks up the knife from the drawer. Cuts the chicken on the cutting board. Cuts the broccoli into pieces. Cuts the onion into slices. Picks up the pan. Places the pan on the induction cooker. Presses the induction cooker power button. Pours oil into the pan. Puts the chicken into the pan with the spatula. Stirs the chicken. Adds the onion and broccoli. Stirs again. Presses the button to lower the heat. Opens the oven door. Places the tray of potatoes inside. Closes the oven door. Turns the oven dial to 200 degrees. Presses the range hood button to turn it on. Stirs the pan again. Presses the induction cooker button to stop the heat. Picks up two plates from the cupboard. Divides the food onto the plates.

Carries the two plates to the table. Puts one plate in front of Member 2. Puts the other plate at the own seat. Opens the oven door. Takes out the tray of potatoes with the mitts. Closes the oven door. Puts the potatoes into a bowl. Places the bowl on the table. Pulls the chair out. Sits down. Picks up the fork. Cuts the chicken. Eats. Drinks water from the glass. Says 'The potatoes came out well' to Member 2. Picks up the salt shaker. Shakes salt onto the potatoes. Puts the shaker down. Continues eating with the fork. Cuts the broccoli. Eats it. Picks up the glass. Drinks. Puts the glass down. Says 'I have the grant report due Friday' to Member 2. Picks up the fork again. Finishes the food on the plate. Puts the fork down on the plate. Leans back in the chair. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up the plates from the table. Carries them to the sink. Picks up the fork and the glass. Carries them to the sink. Puts the leftover food into the bin with the spatula. Opens the dishwasher door. Pulls out the lower rack. Places the plates in the rack. Places the forks in the basket. Places the glasses in the upper rack. Places the bowls in the rack. Pushes the lower rack in. Pushes the upper rack in. Closes the dishwasher door. Picks up the detergent box. Opens the dispenser lid. Pours the detergent into the dispenser. Closes the lid. Presses the dishwasher start button. Picks up the sponge. Wipes the counter with the sponge. Rinses the sponge under the tap. Puts the sponge on the holder. Picks up the cloth. Wipes the table. Hangs the cloth on the rail. Turns the range hood off. Turns the kitchen light off. Walks out of the kitchen.

Walks into the living room. Sits down on the sofa next to Member 2. Picks up the TV remote from the coffee table. Presses the power button. Points the remote at the TV and selects a series. Puts the remote down on the cushion. Leans back. Watches the screen. Picks up the remote. Turns the volume up two steps. Puts the remote down. Says 'This is the episode we missed' to Member 2. Picks up the water glass from the table. Drinks. Puts the glass down. Picks up the remote. Pauses the show. Presses play again. Watches the screen. Picks up the phone. Checks the time. Puts the phone down. Picks up the remote. Turns the volume down one step.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and playing a game console for evening leisure
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up the game console controller from the shelf. Presses the console power button. Waits for the console to start. Selects a two-player game with the controller buttons. Hands the second controller to Member 2. Presses the start button. Moves the joystick with the left thumb. Presses the A button with the right thumb. Presses the B button. Leans forward on the sofa. Presses the shoulder button. Says 'I got it' to Member 2. Presses the joystick to the right. Presses the A button again. Pauses the game with the menu button. Picks up the water glass. Drinks. Puts the glass down. Presses the menu button to resume. Plays another round. Loses the round. Puts the controller down on the coffee table. Says 'One more round' to Member 2. Picks the controller up again. Plays another round. Wins the round. Puts the controller down. Presses the console power button to turn it off. Stands up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the bathroom. Turns the light switch on. Turns the water heater switch on. Turns the shower tap to the left. Holds the right hand under the water to test the temperature. Steps into the shower. Rubs the soap over the arms, chest and legs. Rinses the body under the water. Picks up the shampoo bottle. Pours shampoo into the left palm. Rubs the scalp with both hands. Rinses the head. Turns the tap to the right to stop the water. Steps out of the shower. Pulls the towel off the rail. Rubs the hair with the towel. Wipes the arms, chest and legs. Hangs the towel on the rail. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto it. Brushes the teeth. Rinses the mouth with water. Spits into the sink. Puts the toothbrush back in the holder. Turns the dehumidifier switch on. Turns the light switch off. Opens the door. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and scrolling on the phone under the desk lamp with the fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into Bedroom 1. Sits down on the edge of the bed. Picks up the phone from the bedside table. Presses the power button. Unlocks the screen. Opens the reading app. Scrolls down with the thumb. Reads a page. Turns to the next page. Picks up the book from the bedside table. Opens it at the bookmark. Reads two pages. Puts the book down on the bedside table. Presses the desk lamp switch to turn it on. Adjusts the lamp arm toward the bed. Presses the fan switch to turn the fan on. Adjusts the fan to the low setting. Picks up the phone again. Opens the messaging app. Reads messages. Types a reply. Sends it. Opens the news app. Scrolls down with the thumb. Puts the phone down on the bedside table. Presses the desk lamp switch off. Presses the fan switch to keep it running. Lies down on the bed. Pulls the blanket up to the chest.

Lies on the bed with the blanket pulled up to the chest. Turns onto the right side. Pulls the pillow under the head. Bends the knees. Closes the eyes. Breathes slowly and evenly. Rolls onto the back. Extends the left arm on the mattress. Rolls onto the left side. Pulls the blanket up over the shoulder. Remains still. Turns the head to the other side. Remains lying without movement. Continues breathing slowly through the night.
